topics.title: Matter & Measurement
topics.summary: Start by examining material properties, physical and chemical changes, and measurable quantities.

topics.title: Atoms, Ions & Isotopes
topics.summary: Understand protons, neutrons, electrons, ions, and isotopes via atomic and mass numbers.

topics.title: Periodic Table & Electrons
topics.summary: Use groups and periods to predict simple trends in element properties.

topics.title: Bonding & Molecular Shape
topics.summary: Study ionic and covalent bonding and how molecular geometry affects polarity.

topics.title: Moles & Stoichiometry
topics.summary: Connect amount of substance, molar mass, and balanced equation coefficients.

topics.title: Solutions & Concentration
topics.summary: Understand solutions, solvents, solutes, molarity, and dilution.

topics.title: Acids, Bases & pH
topics.summary: Differentiate acids and bases and understand logarithmic pH in aqueous solutions.

topics.title: Gases & Gas Laws
topics.summary: Apply pressure, volume, absolute temperature, and gas amount relations to simple cases.

topics.title: Thermochemistry & Energy
topics.summary: Understand heat exchange, system/surroundings, and enthalpy change signs.

topics.title: Kinetics & Equilibrium
topics.summary: Separate reaction rate from equilibrium position and understand catalysts.

topics.title: Redox & Electrochemistry
topics.summary: Track electron transfer, oxidation states, and electrochemical cell reactions.

topics.title: Introduction to Organic Chemistry
topics.summary: Recognize common functional groups and how molecular structure affects properties.

topics.title: Laboratory Safety & Scientific Ethics
topics.summary: Apply safety, chemical labeling, data honesty, and environmental responsibility.
